name: Escalation delivery and detail completeness
purpose: offline cases with a fake Quest client: assignee fallback chain and never an unaddressed ask, kind, hold or proceed default, deadline, review link, team routing, duplicate open asks, backend failure Read in this direction: maximise the share of escalations that reach a named person with the detail needed to decide; minimise unaddressed and duplicate asks, and default safely to hold when no one answers. Measures delivery and detail, not whether the brain chose to confirm instead of act (that is route-a-message).
record: The pass rate, passed cases out of cases run, of the live implementation on the rule's cases, recorded as a row of the results file pinned to the commit and the cases hash; a rule holds or does not, so the implementations are never ranked and a deliberately broken baseline must fail the same cases.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the quest_decision_sink offline arm of escalate_to_a_human runs the whole case set with no model call]
